bike.tagline: Durability over performance — tuned for Marrakech heat, dust and traffic.

rows: Champion P-RZ9HC (OEM) · Marrakech: NGK CR7HSA · gap 0.6-0.7 mm
~70 km/h (Moroccan market) · cruise 45-55 km/h for engine life
Gear reduction in sealed oil bath (no chain)
6 pcs, ~6-7 g · Ø16 mm new · replace < 15.4 mm
SAE 15W-40 API SF · 700 ml change / 800 ml rebuild
10W-40 → 10W-50/60 in summer · JASO MB · semi/full synthetic
2.0 bar solo (29 PSI) · 2.25 bar two-up (32 PSI)
Hydraulic disc Ø180 mm, single-piston caliper

tasks.name: Engine oil change
tasks.label: 300 · 1,000 · 2,000 · 3,000 km, then every 2,000 km
tasks.notes: 700 ml, JASO MB (dry clutch — never MA/MA2). Ipone R4000 SCOOT until 5,000 km, then KATANA SCOOT full synthetic. Summer: 10W-50/10W-60. The one item never to economise on.

tasks.name: Oil screen clean
tasks.label: Ideally each oil change · never over 4,000 km
tasks.notes: Centrifugal metal screen. Clean every oil change in summer; absolute max 4,000 km (two oil changes). Replace if torn or deformed.

tasks.name: Gear oil change
tasks.label: 300 · 1,000 km, then every 4,000 km
tasks.notes: 80W-90 GL-4, 120-150 ml. Every other engine oil change. Missed one break-in change? Do it now — the cheapest insurance on the final drive.

tasks.name: Air filter clean
tasks.label: Every 1,000 km or monthly
tasks.notes: Viscous paper element — never liquid. Tap, then blow compressed air from inside out. Re-check idle afterwards. Summer: every 500-750 km and after every dust storm.

tasks.name: Air filter replace
tasks.label: Every 3,000-5,000 km
tasks.notes: HifloFiltro recommended. Inspect the airbox foam seal every time — a cracked seal bypasses the filter completely. Re-adjust idle after fitting.

tasks.name: CVT intake foam filter
tasks.label: Every 1,000 km
tasks.notes: Small foam on the CVT cover air intake (not the engine filter). A blocked one overheats the belt.

tasks.name: Carburettor pilot jet clean
tasks.label: Every 6,000 km or at first symptom
tasks.notes: Symptoms: rough idle, stalling at lights, hard cold starts. Never poke jets with wire.

tasks.name: Fuel filter replace
tasks.label: Every 6,000 km
tasks.notes: Inline filter. Look at it every oil change — dark brown means change it now.

tasks.name: Spark plug read & clean
tasks.label: Every 2,000 km
tasks.notes: Brush off carbon, set gap 0.6-0.7 mm. Read the colour — it is a free diagnostic.

tasks.name: Spark plug replace
tasks.label: Every 5,000 km
tasks.notes: NGK CR7HSA (one step colder than OEM, for the heat). Gap 0.6-0.7 mm, 10-14 N·m.

tasks.name: Valve clearance check
tasks.label: Every 4,000 km
tasks.notes: IN 0.08 mm / EX 0.08 mm, engine cold. Clearance drifting fast after adjustment = worn valve guides.

tasks.name: CVT belt & roller inspection
tasks.label: Every 5,000 km
tasks.notes: Measure belt width (replace < 16.5 mm), roll each roller on a flat surface, blow out the dust. Rollers are the #1 failure on this bike in heat.

tasks.name: Variator rollers replace
tasks.label: Every 10,000 km or first flat spot
tasks.notes: Always replace all 6 as a matched set. Stock 6-7 g or slightly heavier for durability.

tasks.name: Drive belt replace
tasks.label: Every 8,000 km or < 16.5 mm
tasks.notes: New width 17.5 mm. Measuring is free — replacing at 5,000 km wastes ~40% of belt life.

tasks.name: Centrifugal clutch inspection
tasks.label: Every 10,000 km
tasks.notes: Spring tension and lining thickness (< 2.0 mm = replace). Bike creeping at idle = tired springs.

tasks.name: Throttle cable lubrication
tasks.label: Every 5,000 km
tasks.notes: Then verify 2-6 mm free play — the throttle must snap shut.

tasks.name: Brake pads inspection
tasks.label: Every 3,000 km
tasks.notes: Replace at ≤ 1 mm lining. Scraping noise = metal on metal, stop riding.

tasks.name: Brake fluid replace
tasks.label: Every 12 months or 8,000 km
tasks.notes: DOT 4 from a sealed bottle. Hygroscopic: Marrakech heat drops its boiling point long before the factory interval.

tasks.name: Brake caliper clean & lube
tasks.label: Every 6,000 km
tasks.notes: Dust + heat seize the piston. Push back, clean, thin coat of silicone grease.

tasks.name: Full brake system inspection
tasks.label: Every 10,000 km
tasks.notes: Cables, hoses, fluid level/condition, pads and rear shoes.

tasks.name: Tyre pressure check
tasks.label: Weekly
tasks.notes: Cold: front 1.75 bar, rear 2.0 bar solo / 2.25 bar two-up. Expect +3-5 PSI when hot.

tasks.name: Tyre condition check
tasks.label: Weekly
tasks.notes: Tread ≥ 1 mm, sidewall cracks, embedded debris. Best tyre: Michelin City Grip 2; value: City Extra.

tasks.name: Battery check
tasks.label: Every 2,000 km
tasks.notes: > 12.4 V at rest, > 13 V running. Batteries last 2-3 years in Marrakech.

tasks.name: Starter motor brushes
tasks.label: Every 15,000 km
tasks.notes: Slow cranking on a good battery = worn brushes. Kick-start now and then to spare the starter.

tasks.name: Bolts & fasteners torque check
tasks.label: Every 8,000 km
tasks.notes: Axles, engine mounts, handlebar clamps, caliper bolts. See torque table.

genericTasks.name: Engine oil change
genericTasks.notes: Use the grade and quantity in your owner's manual. Scooters with a dry centrifugal clutch need JASO MB oil. In summer heat don't stretch the interval: oil is the engine's only cooling margin.

genericTasks.name: Oil filter / screen
genericTasks.notes: Cartridge filter: replace. Metal screen: clean it. Easiest at an oil change.

genericTasks.name: Final drive (gear) oil
genericTasks.notes: Usually 80W-90 or 10W-40 depending on the model, a small quantity (100-250 ml). Check the manual.

genericTasks.name: Air filter check
genericTasks.notes: Paper elements: tap and blow from the inside out, never wash. Foam elements: wash and re-oil. After a dust storm, check it right away.

genericTasks.name: Air filter replace
genericTasks.notes: Fine dust wears the cylinder. Replace earlier if it stays dark after cleaning.

genericTasks.name: CVT air intake filter
genericTasks.notes: The small filter on the CVT cover intake (not every scooter has one). Blocked = hot belt.

genericTasks.name: Carburettor cleaning
genericTasks.notes: Or at the first symptom: hard starting, rough idle, stalling at lights. Never poke jets with wire.

genericTasks.name: Fuel filter replace
genericTasks.notes: Cheap inline filter. Dark brown inside means change it now.

genericTasks.name: Throttle body & injector clean
genericTasks.notes: Carbon at the throttle plate causes an unstable idle. Use throttle-body cleaner, not carb spray on sensors.

genericTasks.name: Spark plug replace
genericTasks.notes: Use the plug reference from the manual. Its colour is a free health check: light brown is good.

genericTasks.name: Valve clearance check
genericTasks.notes: Engine cold. A ticking top end or hard hot starts are signs the clearance has drifted.

genericTasks.name: Coolant level check
genericTasks.notes: Engine cold, scooter upright: between MIN and MAX in the reserve tank. Never open the radiator cap hot.

genericTasks.name: Coolant replace
genericTasks.notes: Ready-mixed coolant for aluminium engines. Old coolant corrodes the pump and overheats in summer.

genericTasks.name: Radiator & hoses check
genericTasks.notes: Rinse dust and insects off the fins with a gentle stream (no pressure washer). Look for cracked or soft hoses.

genericTasks.name: CVT belt & rollers inspection
genericTasks.notes: Measure the belt width, look for flat spots on the rollers, blow out the dust. Free while the cover is open.

genericTasks.name: Variator rollers replace
genericTasks.notes: Replace the whole set together, never one by one.

genericTasks.name: Drive belt replace
genericTasks.notes: Or earlier when it is below the minimum width in the manual. A snapped belt leaves you stranded.

genericTasks.name: Centrifugal clutch inspection
genericTasks.notes: Lining thickness and springs. Creeping at idle or juddering pull-away = worn clutch.

genericTasks.name: Brake pads inspection
genericTasks.notes: Replace at 1 mm of lining or less. A scraping noise means metal on metal: stop riding.

genericTasks.name: Brake fluid replace
genericTasks.notes: DOT 4 from a sealed bottle. It absorbs moisture and boils sooner in the heat.

genericTasks.name: Tyre pressure check
genericTasks.notes: Cold, with a gauge. Pressures are on a sticker under the seat or in the manual.

genericTasks.name: Tyre condition check
genericTasks.notes: Tread at least 1 mm, no sidewall cracks, nothing stuck in the tread.

genericTasks.name: Rear tyre replace
genericTasks.notes: The rear wears faster than the front. Michelin City Grip 2 is the best all-round city scooter tyre.

genericTasks.name: Front tyre replace
genericTasks.notes: Front and rear tyres are built differently (front marked F): never swap them.

genericTasks.name: 12 V battery check
genericTasks.notes: Above 12.4 V at rest. Heat and vibration kill batteries in 2-3 years.

genericTasks.name: Traction battery & charger check
genericTasks.notes: Range compared with new, connectors clean and tight, charger cable intact. Avoid charging in direct sun.

genericTasks.name: Throttle cable check & lube
genericTasks.notes: 2-6 mm free play; the throttle must snap shut by itself.

genericTasks.name: Bolts & fasteners check
genericTasks.notes: Axles, engine mounts, handlebar clamps, brake caliper bolts.

checklist.title: Engine oil level
checklist.detail: Dipstick, bike upright on centre stand — between the two marks.

checklist.title: Tyres look right
checklist.detail: Not flat, not bulging. Gauge check weekly.

checklist.title: Front brake lever
checklist.detail: Firm, no sponge, bites within the first third of travel.

checklist.title: Rear brake
checklist.detail: 10-20 mm free play before it engages.

checklist.title: Lights & signals
checklist.detail: Low/high beam, tail, brake light on both levers, indicators.

checklist.title: Fuel level
checklist.detail: Don't ride on fumes — sediment gets sucked into the carb.

checklist.title: Throttle
checklist.detail: 2-6 mm slack, snaps closed when released.

checklist.title: Mirrors
checklist.detail: Adjusted and tight — vibration loosens them.

checklist.title: Stands
checklist.detail: Centre/side stand retract fully and stay up.

checklist.title: Tyre pressure with gauge
checklist.detail: Cold: F 1.75 bar · R 2.0 bar (2.25 two-up).

checklist.title: Tyre condition
checklist.detail: Tread ≥ 1 mm, no sidewall cracks, no embedded debris.

checklist.title: Cooling fins clean
checklist.detail: Brush dust off cylinder & head fins — #1 overheating cause.

checklist.title: Under-seat area
checklist.detail: Water ingress, loose items, rodent damage to wiring.

checklist.title: Listen to the CVT
checklist.detail: Short test ride: no squeal, no grinding from the rear.

localTips.title: Summer (May-Sep)
localTips.text: Check cooling fins more often — dust builds up fast at 40 °C+.

localTips.title: After a dust storm
localTips.text: Inspect the air filter immediately; one day can clog it.

localTips.title: Parked > 2 weeks
localTips.text: Drain the carburettor float bowl before restarting — stale fuel varnishes the pilot jet.

localTips.title: Rainy season (Oct-Mar)
localTips.text: Pump the brakes a few times to dry the disc; check for rust.

kill.q: Is the kill switch in RUN?

crank.q: Key ON, press start (brake held): does the starter crank?
options: No — nothing or just a click

fire.q: Does the engine fire briefly then die?
options: Yes, fires but won't stay running

r-kill.result: Flip the kill switch to RUN
r-kill.text: Then try again. It happens to everyone.

r-battery.text: Charge it. If it won't hold a charge, replace (YTX4L-BS, 12 V 4 Ah). Check charging when running: > 13 V. Use the kick-start meanwhile.

r-nocrank.text: Check the 7 A fuse, starter relay, connections, side-stand switch (must be up) and that a brake lever is held. All OK → worn starter brushes or seized motor.

r-fuel.result: Fuel delivery — likely the pilot jet
r-fuel.text: Check fuel level. Disconnect the line at the carb: fuel should drip. If fuel reaches the carb, the pilot jet is clogged — clean it. Bike sat > 2 weeks in summer? Drain the float bowl first.

r-spark.text: Remove the plug, ground it on the head, crank. No spark → CDI, coil, kill-switch wiring. Spark but no fire → fuel not reaching the cylinder (clogged jet, stuck float, empty tank).

options: Only at high speed / full throttle

r-all.text: Check in order: 1) air filter (clogged = rich), 2) spark plug (fouled/worn), 3) exhaust carbon, 4) valve clearance — tight valves kill compression (IN/EX 0.08 mm cold).

r-low.text: Pilot jet clogged (most likely in Marrakech). Also check for a cracked intake rubber (vacuum leak) and the idle air screw.

r-high.text: 1) Flat-spotted rollers: revs rise but speed doesn't. 2) Worn belt slips (replace < 16.5 mm). 3) Partly clogged main jet.

options: Ticking from the top of the engine

tick.q: Does the ticking speed up with RPM?

r-valves.text: Adjust IN/EX 0.08 mm cold. If it drifts again quickly, the valve guides are worn (cylinder head job).

r-loose.text: Look for loose heat shields, exhaust mount bolts or fan shroud contact.

r-rear.text: Check gear oil level first (level with the check-bolt hole, bike upright); top up 80W-90 GL-4. Still noisy → drain and look for metal particles; workshop.

r-squeal.text: Belt worn, glazed or oily. Inspect; replace if < 16.5 mm or shiny. Belt OK → clean variator/clutch drum with brake cleaner. Never oil inside the CVT.

r-scrape.result: Pads worn to metal — stop riding
r-scrape.text: Replace the front pads now (min 1 mm lining). Check the disc for deep grooves (min 3.0 mm thickness).

now.q: Loss of power, pinging, hot or burnt-oil smell?

r-now.text: Lower RPM, avoid full throttle, keep moving at moderate speed for airflow. If pinging/knocking: stop and let it cool 10-15 minutes.

r-cause.text: 1) Blocked cooling fins (#1 cause here) — brush them. 2) Oil low or old — top up / change. 3) Fan blades or shroud broken. 4) Long idling in traffic on 45 °C days. Still hot → lean mixture, wrong plug, internal damage: workshop. DTC P0217 (> 165 °C) = change the oil now.

failureModes.name: CVT variator rollers
failureModes.how: Heat softens the rollers; they flat-spot instead of rolling. Hesitation, RPM hunting, extra belt wear, eventually a snapped belt.
failureModes.detect: Hesitation on acceleration; open the CVT — rollers must be perfectly round, not discoloured.
failureModes.prevent: Inspect every 5,000 km, replace every 10,000 km or at the first flat spot. All 6 together.

failureModes.name: Centrifugal clutch springs
failureModes.how: Heat weakens spring temper: clutch drags at idle, shoes wear, mushy take-off.
failureModes.detect: Bike creeps at idle with brakes released; engagement below ~3,500 rpm.
failureModes.prevent: Inspect every 10,000 km. Avoid long idling in traffic.

failureModes.name: Valve guides
failureModes.how: Air-cooled head in 45 °C heat: guides wear oval. Oil consumption, blue smoke, ticking.
failureModes.detect: Valve clearance drifting quickly after adjustment; rising oil use.
failureModes.prevent: Quality oil every 2,000 km, avoid > 6,500 rpm in heat, keep fins clean.

failureModes.name: Carburettor pilot jet
failureModes.how: Fine dust + fuel sediment block the tiny orifice. Rough idle, stalling, hard starts.
failureModes.detect: Hold the jet to the light — the hole must be perfectly clear.
failureModes.prevent: Air filter discipline, inline fuel filter, fresh fuel (< 2-3 weeks).

failureModes.name: Brake caliper piston
failureModes.how: Dust and heat cycles corrode the piston; brake drags, pads wear unevenly.
failureModes.detect: Wheel doesn't spin freely, disc very hot after riding.
failureModes.prevent: Clean & grease every 6,000 km; brake fluid every 12 months.

failureModes.name: Starter motor brushes
failureModes.how: Stop-and-go traffic means many starts; brushes wear down.
failureModes.detect: Slow cranking with a healthy battery (> 12.4 V).
failureModes.prevent: Inspect at 15,000 km; use the kick-start sometimes.

failureModes.name: Air filter housing seal
failureModes.how: Heat hardens the foam seal; unfiltered dust goes straight into the engine.
failureModes.detect: At each filter service: the seal must be soft and springy, no dust tracks.
failureModes.prevent: Treat the 10-20 MAD seal as a consumable; thin silicone grease.

guides.title: Engine oil change
steps: 2-3 minutes. Warm oil drains faster and carries more dirt out.
Centre stand on flat ground, drain pan under the engine.
Lets air in so it drains faster.
17 mm bolt, bottom-right of the crankcase. Drain 3-5 minutes.
30 mm cap — clean the metal screen, replace if torn (10-20 N·m).
New copper washer, 11-15 N·m. Aluminium case — do not over-tighten.
Through the dipstick hole. Check by resting the dipstick, not screwing it in.
Idle, stop, wait 1 minute, top up between the marks.
Wipe the plug and look again after a short ride.
tips: Engine drain: right side, 17 mm. Gear oil drain: left rear, 12 mm.

guides.title: Gear oil change
steps: Pan under the left rear of the engine.
Upper bolt on the left gear case — proves you can refill before you drain.
Lower 12 mm bolt. Drains in ~2 minutes.
Dark amber is normal. Grey, milky or glittering → have the gears checked.
Until oil just seeps out with the bike upright — that is the level.

guides.title: Air filter service
need: Compressed air (5 MAD at the station)
steps: Left side, under the body panel.
It is viscous paper, not foam.
Tap out dust, blow air from the inside out only. Never water, soap or oil.
Soft and springy. Hard or cracked → replace (10-20 MAD).
No gaps — any unfiltered air is dust in the cylinder.
A clean filter changes the mixture; adjust the idle screw if needed.
tips: After a storm or construction zone, check it the same day.

guides.title: Tyre pressure check
steps: Before riding or 30+ min after. Heat adds 2-4 PSI.
2.0 bar (29 PSI) solo · 2.25 bar (32 PSI) two-up.
On, and no cracks at the valve base.
Tread ≥ 1 mm, sidewalls, nails, uneven wear.

guides.title: Pilot jet cleaning
guides.interval: Every 6,000 km or at first symptom
steps: Close the petcock or clamp the line.
Loosen manifold and airbox clamps, unhook choke and throttle cables.
Small brass jet near the centre.
Spray both directions, hold to light: clean round hole. Soak 15 min if blocked.
Remove varnish; check the float needle and seat.
Jets snug only (brass strips). Bowl screws evenly.
Reconnect, open fuel, let it stabilise.
tips: It enlarges the orifice and permanently changes the mixture.

guides.title: CVT belt & roller inspection
need: Variator holding tool or impact wrench
steps: Cracks, fraying, glazing. Width: 17.5 mm new, replace < 16.5 mm.
Belt dust and grit act as abrasive.
Holding tool; nut is 54-64 N·m on refit.
Roll each on a flat surface: smooth, round, same size (Ø16 mm new, < 15.4 mm = replace).
Any flat spot → replace all 6. Tighten the cover in a star pattern.
tips: Stock 6-7 g. Slightly heavier = lower cruising RPM = longer engine life.

guides.title: Brake caliper piston service
steps: Two bolts; don't let it hang on the hose.
Gently with the lever — not all the way.
Brake-specific only — never petroleum grease near seals.

guides.title: Throttle cable lubrication
steps: Luber tool or drip light oil into the sheath.
Pull in and out to spread it.
2-6 mm at the grip; throttle snaps shut.
Full lock left and right: RPM must not change.
tips: Too little free play = throttle may not close fully.

guides.title: Spark plug reading
steps: Lean: vacuum leak, fuel filter, missing air filter. Mild lean is normal at 460 m.
Rich: clogged air filter or choke stuck.
Oil fouling: guides or rings. Check oil use (> 100 ml/1,000 km = wear).
Too much idling / running rich — clean or replace.
End of life — replace, gap 0.6-0.7 mm.

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.headline: The hardest season on an air-cooled engine.
rows: Check twice a week. 1,500 km in Jul-Aug or switch to 10W-50/10W-60.
Check cold, early morning (+3-5 PSI when hot).
Clean every 500-750 km and after every dust storm.
Shade or a cover: UV kills plastics, seals and tyres.

seasons.name: Winter
seasons.headline: Cold starts and condensation.
rows: Drops ~1 PSI per 5 °C — check more often.
Keep the tank full, use fuel within 2-3 weeks.
First stops are weaker; 3-4 applications to warm up.
Charge if below 12.2 V; capacity drops 20-30%.
Dry the brakes with light applications afterwards.

seasons.name: Spring & autumn
seasons.headline: Best time for the big services.
rows: Comfortable garage temperature for the check.
New element before the dusty season.

storage: Drain the carburettor float bowl — stale fuel varnishes the pilot jet in 2-3 weeks.
Fill the tank to limit condensation.
Battery maintainer, or disconnect the negative terminal.
Breathable cover against dust, UV and rain.
Before restarting: oil, tyres, brakes, battery; idle 2-3 minutes.

warnings.title: Never mix the two oils
warnings.text: Engine 10W-40 (right, 17 mm drain) vs gear 80W-90 (left rear, 12 mm drain). Label your bottles ENGINE and GEARS.

warnings.title: JASO MB, not MA
warnings.text: Dry centrifugal clutch: the oil must be JASO MB scooter-rated.

warnings.title: CVT rollers fail first
warnings.text: Inspect every 5,000 km; replace at the first flat spot.

warnings.title: Keep the passport stamped
warnings.text: Dealer stamps preserve the warranty and are the #1 resale argument.

fixedCosts: Mandatory third-party. Renew before expiry to keep the 2-year loyalty discount.
Single use, keep under the seat.
Oil ×8, filters, plugs, rollers, pads at ~10,000 km/yr.

shops.name: YOUKA Moto
shops.note: Best value labour — default for routine services (warranty kept).

accidentSteps: Get safe: hazard position, off the road, check injuries — call 15 / 19 / 177.
Photograph everything: positions, damage, plates, the road.
Take the other party's plate, insurance certificate and licence details; note a witness.
Fill a constat amiable if both agree; never sign what you don't understand.
Declare to your insurer within 5 days (in writing or against a receipt) — later = loss of cover.
Do not repair before the insurer's expert has seen the damage.

documentTypes.label: Insurance certificate
documentTypes.hint: Renew before expiry — one uncovered day resets the loyalty discount.

documentTypes.label: Registration (carte grise)
documentTypes.hint: Keep it under the seat with the insurance certificate.

documentTypes.label: Driving licence
documentTypes.hint: An expired licence voids insurance cover.

documentTypes.label: Warranty
documentTypes.hint: Keep services stamped by an approved dealer.

items: Jet helmet ECE 22.06, white, dual visor
Mandatory standard; white is cooler and more visible.
~300 MAD used/import; get a vented one for summer.
Vented in summer, windproof long gloves Nov-Feb.
Anchor to a fixed point + steering lock every time.
Low evening sun is a real accident factor.
Givi B29 Monolock top case 29 L
~650 MAD at Mob Shop. Max 3 kg! Add the E176 backrest for passengers.
Less vibration than handlebar mounts — protects your camera's OIS.

resale.headline: Sell around 4-5 years or 40,000 km, whichever first.
resale.text: Before ~40,000 km you pay only consumables; after, guides, clutch, shocks and starter arrive together. Used Agility 50s trade at 5,500-14,500 MAD on Avito — a documented, stamped service history is the #1 price argument.
